items.title: OTTera cuts scheduling time by 60% with AI on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: OTTera, a white-label streaming service powering over 2,000 FAST channels, cut scheduling time by 60% by replacing manual workflows with AI agents built on Amazon Bedrock. In partnership with AI/R Compass UOL, OTTera modernized its core systems and deployed conversational AI that turns proprietary data into real-time scheduling intelligence, with projected Year 1 net profit exceeding $6.3 million*.
items.creator: Venky Hosur

items.title: How Denodo and Amazon SageMaker Deliver a Data Foundation for Agentic AI
items.summary: Agentic AI succeeds or fails on its data foundation, not the model behind it. Denodo and AWS give AI agents governed, real-time access to distributed data across hybrid, multi-cloud, and sovereign environments, without replication. Paired with Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon Quick, Denodo's AI data layer delivers the active context agents need to reason accurately. Learn how a pan-African bank cut integration effort by up to 90%.
items.creator: Carl Luo
